items.note: States h, v, N, m, the triple-indexed banks, the eight-row scratch-cancelling schedule, the signed exchange and restoration, and the wire counts; the derivation follows 741-765 exactly (net change (JV+RG)x, coefficient tables |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2, three-stage shear composition).

Frames D_v, edge operators D_v D_u^{-1}, the invariant, commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S D_in^{-1} and the per-route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} all match 804-826.

Bilinear forms, triple-line orthogonality, terminal labels, stage transitions, the full residual table (only center 3->4 decreasing, loss h), L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L, orthonormal bases over F_2 and L/N=100/539, 101/539 are all present with the paper's edge-by-edge route.

Rank of P_V-P_U equals the dimension change, the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, the endpoint identity M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m and the Phi_M shear frames all appear; the assignment of P_U to gates and sinks is only implicit and the endpoint formula in S1.5.8 is worded loosely (see errors).

Phase frames C_U, one translation kernel aI+bX_v (or inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and C^{tensor mk} on every role after the 27-coordinate Z corrections and undoing the exchange follow 1231-1315; q_U=wt(P_U x) mod 4 is not defined explicitly but is used through weight additivity.
Exact deficits eta_b, eta_c, the bound eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20, the exponential inequality and s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} are stated and derived as in 1319-1346.

Lexicographic storage, the four elementary operations, controlled shifts by cutting fibers at Q-a, absorption of b^{O(1)} offset work, and multiplication by a unit via c increasing pieces follow the proofs at 513-550 and 574-604.
E_1 Pi E_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, the prime choice, linear-cost triangular transforms, and the three-step one-interchange implementation of H_i<-H_i+D_j match 1375-1447.

Row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_M frames, shear on every role, the three-shear interchange, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric-sum solution and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule all follow 1491-1615.
High digits as row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces, binary-to-radix-q padding and the one-bit unequal-width case match 1649-1762.

Conjugation by P_M, the inverse-child identity, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes per group of e=mf axes, a fixed number of binary row additions, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D are stated with the paper's route.

Eight packed operations and their cycles, guard interval [10,2^{K-1}-11], delta_bad by union bound, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, swap-rotate-swap implementation, radix-sort repair and the cost bound all match 2013-2231.

Individual kernels at O(Ve), node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks with R_row>=W^{k_0}, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), the internal and leaf sums and the base-m partition giving O(d^{lambda'}) follow 2286-2445.

The layer statement, the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) via A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, eps C_1<1, and the final Q_p error from absolute row sum one match the paper; the proof's check that every packed call meets the lemma's family hypotheses (2696-2735) is only implicit through S2.2.8.

Character cancellation by pairing, decimation in frequency with bit-reversed B_t, the combined twiddle J_E, the layout L, truncation commuting with J_E, the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} and the three-term cost match the paper; the method's description of which slots go to the prefix is slightly off (see errors).
B_0=2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, the separation bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centered extraction, negacyclic reduction and the shift by p+l follow 3233-3368.
Retained LB order with pointwise products commuting with LB, the normalization identity, the 2delta, 3delta+eta and M(3delta+eta) error steps and the cost match 3414-3495.

N=CTD, quoted Gaussian identity and estimate, Neumann inversion, A=S/2 and B_0=D'J'C with the 2^{-2alpha^2} normalization, the error and time table, tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2 and the axis-exposure cost follow the paper.
Period of the chirp, the coefficient computation for QF_t, F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+, RF^+R=F^+, the normalized convolution rule giving (u*v)/S^2 and conjugation all match 3938-3988.

All fixed rationals, the size parameters, alpha, gamma, eta, the prime-interval bound, T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} prime search, no wraparound and the capacity bound are stated and checked as in the paper.

Isomorphism by monomial orders, the triangular mixed-radix formula, padding scan, updates in order i=d..1 as controlled cyclic shifts preserving the valid set, and the O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) cost match 4216-4291.

Theta: x_d -> zeta y as a diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T and the computed twists with phase-product error below 4h_p follow the paper.

Source transform A, chirp, B_0 and 2^gamma with counterpart RF_s, conjugate opposite procedure, digit scaling 2^{-b-2}, and the six steps (Phi, two transforms, product, F^+, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries) match 4454-4534.

The error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2), E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L and the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 with disk margins, rounding and the carry recurrence follow 4546-4806.

All nine table rows with their powers, the seven margins with min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, the justification of each row, setup and exceptional-stream costs o(V), absorption of log factors by p^kappa and the schoolbook cutoff match the paper.
S0 says the bound disproves the n log n conjecture in this model, but no step gives the eventual-lower-bound formulation or the liminf argument of 381-387.

errors.says: Method: 'Move the top slots into a prefix (about dK slot moves)'.
errors.paper: The prefix receives the top slot (i,l-1) of each long axis and then the bottom b=(l-1) mod K slots h=b-1,...,0 of every axis, so the remaining part of each axis is q consecutive K-bit chunks; it is not 'the top slots'.

errors.says: The endpoint difference is P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on every role.
errors.paper: That formula holds on the X_a route only; every other role has zero source matrix and identity sink matrix, giving I_m directly. The conclusion I_m on every role is right.

errors.says: Per-record or per-line descriptor work is O(Tp^{A+C}/r)=o(Tp).
errors.paper: Per-record work over the recursion visits is O(Tp^{A+C}/r), while per-line setup for Gaussian lines is counted separately as O(dTp^C/r), using at most 2dT/r lines per tensor map; both are o(Tp).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end: bit network with frames and labels gives s<Wm and the O(Vu^tau) chunk swap (S1), the complex network with phase frames and packed row additions gives the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer (S2), these feed the synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S3), resampling with retained permutations and the chirp (S4), the six-step algorithm with exact recovery (S5), and the margin table with min g_i=2kappa (S6). It thins out only at the uniformity check of the packed-call hypotheses inside the layer proof (2696-2735), which is left implicit, and at the conjecture-negation clause, which is only named.

steps.note: h=100, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by a in T^3, N=v^3, m=h^3 and the fixed three-stage network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire are all stated.
Common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and edges costing only the frame change D_v D_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspace labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the central 3->4 edges as the only decreasing edges, each losing h.
S1.5.8 states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the N source exceptions with edge matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one.
Sum of absolute dimension changes Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, giving deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, so s<Wm.
Endpoint identity giving I_m on every role and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every role, including scratch roles, with Phi_M frames.
Rank-a shear via A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so a node makes s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, hence F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining quantities, in the paper's order: the fixed bank-exchange network, frames, subspace labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-N+2L, the strict saving L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving the shear, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}.
